questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B', and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

How is T related to O if 'P + N - S ÷ O + M × T'?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: P + N - S ÷ O + M × T

It means:

 
• P + N: P is the mother of N
 
• N - S: N is the brother of S
 
• S ÷ O: S is the father of O
 
• O + M: O is the mother of M
 
• M × T: M is the wife of T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fccb39ed90425dd3217ffbe8ebfb061ae16ae7dc0d77e446d3d2284851da6add.png] 

So, T is the **Daughter's husband** of O.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:** Some horses are rocks. Some rocks are leaves. No rock is a tree.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No horse is a tree.

(II) At least some leaves are trees.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some horses are rocks.

Some rocks are leaves.

No rock is a tree.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33cc0f3e69ed3ae987d12078401fb93a5e6e48b96add76cc13af5594834409b2.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No horse is a tree - False (Because, we only know that no rock is a tree. Some horses being rocks does not imply that no horse can be a tree. It's possible that some horses are not rocks and could be trees.)

II. At least some leaves are trees - False (Because, we know that no rock is a tree, and since some rocks are leaves, those leaves cannot be trees. Therefore, it's not necessary that some leaves are trees.)

So, neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:** Some pens are red. All red are blue.

**Conclusion 1:** All pens are blue.

**Conclusion 2:** Some pens are not red.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

1. Some pens are red.

2. All red are blue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09f388faebee9675d18fba3243827aef931e1825dc6f3c6a2a36845b433d2bf1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pens are blue - **False** (Because only some pens are red, and all red are blue, it does not imply that all pens are blue).

II. Some pens are not red - **False** (It is indefinite, as per the Venn diagram, it may or may not be possible).

So, Neither I nor II conclusion follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
